sources.entry: Calibre Web - Browse, read and download eBooks using an existing Calibre database. GPL-3.0 Python
Calibre-web | Web app for browsing, reading, and downloading eBooks

summary.one_liner: Calibre-Web is a web app for browsing, reading, and downloading eBooks from an existing Calibre library database.
summary.what_it_does: Calibre-Web provides a browser interface on top of a Calibre library (the folder containing metadata.db). It offers book browsing with advanced search and filtering, custom shelves, in-browser reading for multiple formats, and downloads. It includes an OPDS feed for eBook reader apps and a "Magic Link" login for eReaders. Admins get user management with per-user permissions, a web-based setup, and options to edit or delete metadata, upload books, and send books to e-readers. Kobo device sync, Calibre Custom Columns support, and LDAP, Google/GitHub OAuth, and proxy authentication are also listed. Format conversion and metadata editing rely on the optional Calibre desktop binaries.
use_cases: host a personal eBook library in a browser
browse and read eBooks from a Calibre database
serve an OPDS catalog to eBook reader apps
sync a Kobo device with a Calibre library
send books to an e-reader with one click
manage multi-user access to a shared book collection
notable: Works with an existing Calibre metadata.db rather than its own library format
OPDS feed and Magic Link login for eReader apps
Fine-grained per-user permissions and content hiding by category or custom column
Multiple login options including LDAP, Google/GitHub OAuth, and proxy auth
caveats: Format conversion and metadata editing need the separate Calibre desktop binaries; Kobo support needs the Kepubify tool
Default admin credentials (admin/admin123) must be changed; the README lists them openly
Installation notes mention Raspberry Pi OS issues that may need extra packages such as cargo
